propositions: recheck-review currently refuses any current-revision finding state, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks, treating all findings as requiring code changes rather than plan updates
bugfix-size-attestation findings should be accepted via recheck-review when the ticket carries a valid, current plan-review attestation in accepted bucket (certified, stale-code, stale-head)
recheck-review must validate eligibility from only the bot's own vote message and ticket store, never from the requesting comment, to prevent privilege escalation

recheck-review must refuse blocks containing bugfix-size-attestation mixed with other blocking findings, absent attestations, flagged verdicts (stale-material, mismatch, invalid), or infra errors (unavailable, error)

the retrigger accept path must extract ticket id from commit-message trailer via ticket_for_commit_message, not from the truncated finding detail text, and verify the header count is exactly 1 to detect truncation
